A '''town''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> [[Tiems (planet)|Tiems]]<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30847766|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-03-31|quote=Re Tiems, yes, city of Tiems on planet of same name. Thinking is the Rebel Sourcebook had ample opportunity to name a planet but didn't, and 'Battle of Tiems' implies a larger conflict, so Tiems it is. Both admittedly judgment calls, but the Atlas demanded a bunch of those.}}</ref> was the site of a portion of the [[Battle of Tiems]].<ref name="RAS2" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The town was first mentioned in [[Paul Murphy]]'s [[1990]] ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
